# Swans Therapy

> A Bournemouth and Poole-based therapy practice offering hypnotherapy, psychotherapy, counselling, and HypnoReiki™ for mental health conditions and personal development.

Founded by Joy Sackett-Wood and John, Swans Therapy is a BACP-accredited practice providing evidence-based treatments for anxiety, PTSD, OCD, and other conditions. The practice also offers professional therapist training, workshops, and free self-help resources.

## Key Topics

- Hypnotherapy
- Psychotherapy
- Counselling
- HypnoReiki™
- Mental Health
- Anxiety Treatment
- PTSD & Trauma
- Couples Therapy
- Emotional Freedom Technique (EFT)
- Life Coaching
- Professional Development
- Bournemouth & Poole
- BACP Accreditation
- Confidence Building
- Stress Management

- [Therapies](https://swanstherapy.co.uk/services/therapies): Therapy services: counselling, hypnotherapy, psychotherapy, life coaching
- [Treatments](https://swanstherapy.co.uk/services/treatments): Mental health treatments: anxiety, PTSD, OCD, IBS, pain management
- [Benefits of Therapy](https://swanstherapy.co.uk/about/benefits-of-therapy): Benefits of therapy including hypnotherapy, mindfulness, and HypnoReiki™
- [Timescales & Fees](https://swanstherapy.co.uk/about/treatments-timescales-and-fees): Therapy pricing, session fees, and treatment timescales for services
